messages:
Sasha: Quick follow-up from the DB fail postmortem — we need clear owners, Jira links, and handoff steps. I sketched assignments below, please ACK or update.
Alex: Ack. I'll take infra remediation + rollout (RED-5912). ETA 2w. I'll coordinate canary windows.
Maria: I can own runtime config fixes and the rollback playbook (RED-5913). ETA 1w. Will add perf/regression checks.
Jon: I'll handle monitoring/alert tuning and dashboards (RED-5914). Need grafana access and the query owner.
Sasha: Proposed RACI: Alex (R), Maria (A), Jon (C), Samir (I/backup). @Samir you OK to be backup for infra during rollout?
Samir: Yep, I can back up Alex. Will pair on the canary plan and be on-call the first deployment day. :thumbsup:
Alex: Created RED-5912 with sub-tasks: infra/ssh-access, kernel-params-check, canary-script. Added schedule note.
Maria: Created RED-5913 and attached the PR template. Adding regression gate: baseline perf + smoke tests. Also created prompt-set for evals.
Jon: Filed RED-5914 and requested Grafana access via infra#88. Posting the initial alert thresholds in the ticket.
oncall-bot: Incident closed by Sasha at 2025-11-18T09:34:00Z — severity downgraded to P3.
Sasha: Checklist for owners (please paste links & short notes into Jira comments):
```
- Link postmortem doc
- Attach PRs
- Add rollout plan & canary windows
- Define success metrics (latency, error-rate)
```

Alex: I'll update RED-5912 with the canary calendar: Mon 10am PT. Adding a post-deploy validation step.
Maria: Noted. Also flagging recurring pattern: weekly cache-eviction spikes. Opening an epic RED-6010 to track recurrence and long-term fixes.
Jon: For monitoring: will add a dedupe window to alerts and a dashboard panel for eviction rate. Will reference RED-6010 for longer-term metric work.
Samir: I'll run a runbook rehearsal next Tue to exercise the handoff and validate the rollback steps. Will add a note to RED-5913/5912.
Sasha: Great — owners, please link PRs + artifacts to the postmortem and their Jira tickets by EOD Fri. If any blocker, ping me directly.
Alex: Confirmed — will add PR links and testing logs after canary. Will tag @Samir on the RED-5912 comments.
Maria: Will add perf baselines and the regression test outputs to RED-5913 once CI finishes.
Jon: Grafana access request approved; pushed earliest dashboard draft to RED-5914.
Sasha: I'll update the postmortem with the RACI table, action-item tracker, and the epic link for recurring patterns. Thanks everyone. :pray:
